name: multimesh_v8t8
notes: v8t8, the compute image: four 2x2 meshes (7+2 on dies 0/2/3, 5+2 on die 1) around the v8 system node (RV64, staging, no CU/vector L2), the partition-aware Kohaku Xache and the station bus, addressing as v8t2. Every die has its own clocks: its mesh wizard drives noc/mat2x/vec AND that die's sysnode clock (out4, 'sys'); its station takes its own 200 MHz bus clock off the fixed control wizard. A LOAD on ANY mesh wizard drops its lock, and every die's sysnode domain (node, Xache partition, interlink) is held in reset until all wizards relock -- retune before a run, never during one; control, station bus, DDR controllers and XDMA stay up.
